rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Grantex provides identity and authorization infrastructure for AI agents. It issues scoped, revocable JWT grant tokens backed by cryptographic agent identity (DIDs), with immutable audit logging and multi-agent delegation chains. Supports offline token verification via published JWKS and includes compliance modules for the EU AI Act and DPDP Act. SOC 2 Type I certified.
